title: National Museum of Ecuador
geometryBasis: The 32-point ovoid map outline spans approximately 122 m by 176 m. The institutional architecture guide places the museum in the Casa de la Cultura complex and describes the roofed Ágora.
sectionBasis: A pale low roof sits behind three horizontal levels of smoked mirrored glazing. The public entrance uses a charcoal sign and pale concrete edge. The surrounding terrain falls toward the park on the south side.
limitations: The mapped envelope and approximate 10 m height control the low oval form. Curtain wall rhythm, roof curvature and service elevations are approximations based on the documented forms.
The museum entrance and lower service plinth are approximate placements. The sloping original DEM supplies terrain context and is preserved without flattening.
floorBasis: The entrance on the Avenida Patria side sits just above the original approach elevation. The lower concrete base follows the falling ground toward the park. Horizontal occupied floors and the roof retain a level datum.
